answer_1.quote: Grapheme-to-phoneme conversion (G2P) plays an important role in the Chinese text-to-speech system (TTS), aiming to convert Chinese text to Pinyin... We build a new balanced dataset using ICL to verify the validity of decoupled learning in DLM.
answer_1.outputs: Pinyin pronunciations for polyphonic characters and generated sentences for corpus creation

answer_2.quote: The accuracy of polyphone disambiguation is used as the evaluation metric in all experiments.
